# denext

> denext is Next.js's App Router, reimplemented for Deno with its own small React. If you
> know Next.js you already know denext — the same file conventions, hooks, and `app/`
> router — but with a zero-npm runtime, Server Components, Server Actions, pages that ship
> 0 KB of JavaScript, and capabilities React can't ship: Qwik-style resumability and
> Astro-style islands. Durable caching runs on Deno's built-in `node:sqlite` (real SQLite).

## Writing denext, not Next.js (the delta an LLM must know)

- **Import from `denext`, not `react`/`react-dom`.** `import { useState } from "denext"`.
  Server-only helpers: `denext/server`; client-only: `denext/client`. There is no `react`
  package (in a compat drop-in `react` is aliased to denext, but new code imports `denext`).
- **No `package.json` / `npm install`.** A denext project has a `deno.json` with a
  `jsr:`/`npm:` imports map. Run with `deno task dev` / `build` / `start`.
- **File conventions match Next's App Router**: `app/page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `loading.tsx`,
  `error.tsx`, `not-found.tsx`, `route.ts`; `generateMetadata`, `generateStaticParams`,
  `cookies()`/`headers()`, `redirect()`/`notFound()`, `"use client"`/`"use server"`.
- **Migrate an existing Next app** in one pass: `denext migrate` (writes `deno.json`,
  rewrites `next/*`+`react` imports to `denext`).
- Full agent reference: [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Brainwires/denext/blob/main/AGENTS.md).

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://denext.dev/docs/getting-started): install, project layout, first route.
- [Routing](https://denext.dev/docs/routing): App Router conventions — dynamic/catch-all, route groups, parallel & intercepting routes.
- [Migrating from Next.js](https://denext.dev/docs/migrating): `denext migrate`, compatibility mode, caveats.

## Build with it

- [Data & caching](https://denext.dev/docs/data): `fetch` caching, `unstable_cache`, ISR/`revalidate`, `use cache` / Cache Components (PPR). The durable store is `node:sqlite`.
- [Rendering strategies](https://denext.dev/docs/rendering): SSR/SSG/ISR/CSR, streaming (on by default), PPR — plus islands & resumability that go beyond Next.
- [Server Actions](https://denext.dev/docs/server-actions): `"use server"`, progressive-enhancement forms, CSRF-defended.
- [Live components](https://denext.dev/docs/live): server components that push over a WebSocket — `useLive`/`usePresence`/`useLiveOptimistic`.
- [Islands & hydration](https://denext.dev/docs/islands): `client:load | idle | visible | interaction | media | only` per-component lazy hydration.
- [Resumability](https://denext.dev/docs/resumability): `export const resumable = true`, `qrl()`, `useSignal`/`useStore` — interactive with no up-front hydration.
- [SPA mode](https://denext.dev/docs/spa): `mode: "spa"` runs a client-only React app (no `app/`) on denext's toolchain.
- [Middleware](https://denext.dev/docs/middleware): `middleware.ts`, matchers, redirects/rewrites/headers.
- [Auth](https://denext.dev/docs/auth): first-party `denextAuth` — OAuth 2.0 / OIDC + Credentials, signed sessions.
- [Databases](https://denext.dev/docs/database): built-in `node:sqlite` (real SQLite) and Deno KV; Postgres/Drizzle/Prisma via drivers.

## Polish

- [Metadata & SEO](https://denext.dev/docs/metadata): `metadata`, `generateMetadata`, file-based `opengraph-image`/`sitemap`/`robots`.
- [Styling](https://denext.dev/docs/styling): CSS Modules, Tailwind v4 (managed), global CSS.
- [Images](https://denext.dev/docs/images): `next/image` optimization, local + allowlisted remote sources.
- [Browser APIs](https://denext.dev/docs/browser-apis): what runs where; client-only escape hatches.

## Ship it

- [Testing](https://denext.dev/docs/testing): `denext/testing` — `createTestApp`, `render`/`fireEvent`.
- [Deployment](https://denext.dev/docs/deploy): Docker / Deno Deploy / self-host; least-privilege permissions.
- [Desktop apps](https://denext.dev/docs/desktop): package as a native desktop app via Deno Desktop (no Electron).
